title: B6 agent output (b6-blind-solver)
description: Section 10/B6 'Agent output' line and the b6-blind-solver agent file (Appendix B), including its worked example. One run, no retry (Rule/Section 10: 'a retry only argues with itself; the disagreement is the signal') -- this agent must never see the key, coaching material or NCERT (Rule 10).

working.description: Shown for a numerical; empty string when not applicable.

steps.description: The same reasoning, one entry per move, LaTeX throughout, never merged -- so the AI's solution renders step by step beside the publisher's. NOT required: outputs written before the field existed stay valid, and the exporter splits their `working` on sentence boundaries instead of re-running them.

note.description: Used e.g. to flag a value that looks impossible, or that two options look correct / none does.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
